season.name: Spring
season.line: New growth is most exposed when it is youngest.

movement.name: The Eighth Day
movement.line: The winter is past; what was sown is rising.

x: For, behold, the winter is past, the rain is gone, it has departed.
The flowers are seen in the land; the time of pruning has arrived; the voice of the turtle-dove has been heard in our land.

days.t: Behold, I will do new things
x: Behold, I [will] do new things, which shall presently spring forth, and ye shall know them: and I will make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the dry land.

days.t: A new heart and a new spirit
x: And I will give you a new heart, and will put a new spirit in you: and I will take away the heart of stone out of your flesh, and will give you a heart of flesh.

days.t: You renew the face of the ground
x: Thou shalt send forth thy Spirit, and they shall be created; and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

days.t: I will be as dew to Israel
x: I will be as dew to Israel: he shall bloom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Libanus.
His branches shall spread, and he shall be as a fruitful olive, and his smell shall be as [the smell] of Libanus.

days.t: The Spirit who raised Jesus dwells in you
x: And if the Spirit of the One having raised Jesus out from the dead dwells in you⁺, the One having raised Christ Jesus out from the dead will also make alive your⁺ mortal bodies through His Spirit, the One dwelling in you⁺.
